biotools.summary: PIN2GPI is an open-source MATLAB toolbox for automatic detection of gait subphases from plantar pressure signals, enabling the generation of novel digital gait biomarkers. It utilizes data from the Mobilise-D consortium to analyze gait patterns in elderly subjects, particularly those recovering from proximal femur fractures.
